name: Bride
logline_subject_info: An elegant blonde heiress who performs the role of a loving bride for the cameras but is cold and hostile in private.
visual_desc: A photorealistic portrait of a stunningly beautiful woman in her mid-20s with classic Slavic features: high cheekbones, full lips, and piercing ice-blue eyes. She has platinum blonde hair styled in an elegant, intricate updo. Her expression is neutral and unreadable, a mask of cold composure. She wears a luxurious white silk wedding dress with a delicate lace neckline, complemented by a plush white fur wrap draped over her shoulders. A single diamond earring is visible. Her skin is flawless and pale. EDC: Her only carried item is her wedding bouquet (described in a separate ref). The background is a solid deep-charcoal. Soft studio lighting with a faint warm side-light. Wears a white wedding dress and a fur cape.
video_visual_desc: Elegant woman, mid-20s, Slavic features, platinum blonde hair in an updo, wearing a white silk wedding dress and a white fur wrap.
behavioral_signature: Under pressure: immediately creates physical and emotional distance, using sharp, cutting remarks to shut down interaction. Power move: a sudden, complete withdrawal of warmth, replacing a perfect smile with a look of utter disdain. Tell: a subtle, almost imperceptible tightening of her jaw just before her emotional state shifts.
physical_vocabulary: Moves with a calculated, fluid grace in public. In private, her movements become sharp, economical, and dismissive. She uses verticality to assert dominance, such as moving to a higher step on a staircase to look down on someone. She turns her back completely rather than backing away.
